P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The garden is open to the sky with no overhead structure or defined side enclosure; edges are soft and undefined, lacking the sense of an enclosed outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: The garden features a clear tree layer (young deciduous trees), a shrub layer (dense green bushes and perennials), and a ground cover layer (mulch, grass, and low plants), creating a lush, multi-layered appearance.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The wooden carport with the bicycle is the dominant architectural element, drawing the eye and organizing the surrounding planting and hardscape.
